# Parse into rows
rows = {}
for key, val in cells.items():
    # Format is "Travel:R{row}C{col}"
    parts = key.split(':')
    rc = parts[1]
    r = int(rc.split('C')[0][1:])
    c = int(rc.split('C')[1])
    if r not in rows:
        rows[r] = {}
    rows[r][c] = val

# Print as table
headers = rows.get(1, {})
print("ROW | " + " | ".join([str(headers.get(i, '')) for i in range(1, 8)]))
print("-" * 100)
for r in sorted(rows.keys()):
    if r == 1:
        continue
    row_data = rows[r]
    line = f"R{r:2d} | " + " | ".join([str(row_data.get(i, '')) for i in range(1, 8)])
    print(line)

print(f"\\nTotal data rows: {len(rows) - 1}")

conn.close()
"""
